name: B10-0161/2025 (PPE) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the European Union to keep supporting Ukraine against Russia's war and to give Ukraine more weapons, money and training. It asks European countries to spend at least 0.25% of their yearly economic output on military help for Ukraine. It says any peace talks must include Ukraine and Europe. It also asks for a special court to try Russian leaders and for Russian money held in Europe to be taken and used for Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request to European Union governments.
- **Who it affects:** European Union governments, Ukraine, Russia, and people in Europe.
- **What happens next:** Governments decide whether to act on these requests.
